name: Drums
overview: Scripture highlights the use of drums, represented by the timbrel, as an instrument of joyful praise to the LORD. In Psalms 149, the faithful are called to sing new songs and praise God with dancing and musical instruments like the timbrel and harp, emphasizing expressive worship in the congregation of saints. Psalm 150 continues this theme by urging praise to God in His sanctuary with various instruments, underscoring the importance of musical celebration in honoring God's power.
